Context: D. Mileage Allowance for Journeys by Road :

6. Conveyance charges for collecting tickets.Charges admissible by public transport is reimbursable for collecting air/ rail tickets from Railway stations /booking offices, etc. - GIO (7) (f), SR 34.  
7. Agency Charges.Service charges levied by the Traveller's Service Agents recognized by the Zonal Railways is reimbursable.GIO (8), SR 34.
